description: External security-tool manifest for the Kali-side HexStrike server. Tools are checked by command name; install only the profiles you actually use.

external_install_notes.nuclei: ProjectDiscovery binary; install from the official release or Go module. Keep nuclei templates updated separately.
external_install_notes.httpx: Use ProjectDiscovery httpx, not the unrelated Python package with the same name.
external_install_notes.katana: ProjectDiscovery binary; install from official releases or Go.
external_install_notes.subfinder: ProjectDiscovery binary; install from official releases or Go.
external_install_notes.dalfox: Install from the official GitHub release or Go module.
external_install_notes.gau: Install from the official GitHub release or Go module.
external_install_notes.waybackurls: Install from the official GitHub release or Go module.
external_install_notes.arjun: Prefer pipx or an isolated Python virtual environment.
external_install_notes.paramspider: Prefer pipx or the official GitHub repository.
external_install_notes.autorecon: Prefer pipx or the Kali package when available.
external_install_notes.nxc: NetExec; use the current official package/repository. The legacy crackmapexec command is not used here.
external_install_notes.ROPgadget: Installed by the Python package ROPGadget; command name is case-sensitive.
external_install_notes.pwninit: Install the Rust binary from official releases/cargo.
external_install_notes.vol.py: Volatility 3; install in an isolated environment or from the official repository.
external_install_notes.prowler: Install from official Prowler releases/pipx; configure cloud credentials separately.
external_install_notes.scout: ScoutSuite; install in an isolated Python environment.
external_install_notes.trivy: Aqua Security repository or official binary release.
external_install_notes.kube-hunter: Prefer pipx or official container image.
external_install_notes.checkov: Prefer pipx or official container image.
external_install_notes.falco: Install through the official Falco repository; kernel/eBPF support may be required.
external_install_notes.clair: Normally deployed as a service/container, not a single Kali CLI.
external_install_notes.shodan: Install shodan CLI using pipx and configure an API key.
external_install_notes.censys: Install censys CLI using pipx and configure API credentials.

maintenance.projectdiscovery: Update official binaries together and rerun scripts/check_kali_dependencies.py.
maintenance.warning: Do not blindly auto-upgrade every security tool before an engagement. Record versions, test in the lab, then promote the known-good environment.
